message.content:
I don’t have direct access to your network interface, so I can’t measure your current download/upload speeds myself. However, you can quickly find out by running a speed test on your own machine. Here’s how you can do it:

### 1. Using an Online Speed Test Site
- Visit a reputable speed‑testing website such as:
  - [speedtest.net](https://www.speedtest.net/)
  - [fast.com](https://fast.com/) (by Netflix)
  - [speedof.me](https://speedof.me/)
- Click “Go” or “Start” and let the site run its tests. It will report:
  - **Download speed** (Mbps)
  - **Upload speed** (Mbps)
  - **Ping / latency** (ms)

### 2. Using the Command Line (Linux/macOS)
If you prefer a terminal-based test, you can use `speedtest-cli`:

```bash
# Install speedtest-cli if you haven’t already
sudo apt-get install speedtest-cli   # Debian/Ubuntu
brew install speedtest-cli           # macOS (Homebrew)

# Run a test
speedtest
```

This will output your download/upload speeds and ping.

### 3. Using the Command Line (Windows)
On Windows, you can use PowerShell with the `speedtest-cli` Python package:

```powershell
# Install Python if you don’t have it
# Then install speedtest-cli via pip
pip install speedtest-cli

# Run the test
speedtest-cli
```

Alternatively, you can use the built‑in `Test-NetConnection` cmdlet for a quick ping test:

```powershell
Test-NetConnection -ComputerName www.google.com -InformationLevel Detailed
```

### 4. Using Your Router’s Web Interface
Many modern routers provide a status page that shows current throughput. Log into your router’s admin panel (usually at `192.168.0.1` or `192.168.1.1`) and look for a “Status” or “Speed Test” section.

---

#### Quick Tips
- **Run the test at different times** of day to see how traffic affects speed.
- **Connect via Ethernet** (wired) for the most accurate measurement; Wi‑Fi can introduce variability.
- **Check your plan**: Compare the measured speeds against what your ISP advertises.

Let me know if you’d like help interpreting the results or troubleshooting slow speeds!
